about_the_game:
Disruptive Role Reversal:

This time, you're not the savior—you play as the ultimate BOSS controlling humanity's fate!

Story Synopsis

When war between the Enhanced and ordinary humans tears the future apart, rewriting history becomes humanity's final gamble. As a life scientist from the New Epoch, you return to the catastrophe's eve to eliminate genetic disparity through research. Your choices may redeem both timelines, sacrifice one for the other... or plunge all into the abyss.

Story Features

  • Themes: Sci-Fi / Enhanced Abilities / Mystery / Spy / Dual Timelines / Dystopia / Transhumanism

  • Navigate Two Eras: Old Epoch (21st century) & New Epoch (22nd century)

  • Navigate Dual Timelines

    - Old Epoch (~21st c.): A thriving metropolis built upon artificial archipelago, pulsating with hope. Only you know the coming cataclysm's timer is ticking.

    - New Epoch (~22nd c.): The United Earth Federation ended regional wars. A golden age of Enhanced-human-led innovation and universal welfare masks a civilization cracking under genetic disparity.

   Your choices may redeem both timelines, sacrifice one for the other, or plunge all into the abyss.

  • Switch Identities Instantly

    - Surface Persona: A gentle health specialist, seemingly defenseless scholar

    - True Self: A ruthless scientist, elite operative with peak combat prowess

Game Features

  • Gender selection available + name customization

  • 20+ key characters with unique portraits, 4 story branches, 10+ distinct endings

  • Expansive branching choices forge your unique journey

  • Exploration-Driven Mechanics deliver additional information through fragmented storytelling

content_descriptors.notes: This game explores complex moral dilemmas that may exceed the comprehension of younger audiences.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: WIN7 SP1 / WIN8 / WIN10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel CORE i3-3200 or above
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GT750 or above
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: WIN7 SP1 / WIN8 / WIN10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: intel CORE i5-4460 or above
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX980 or above
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: A sci-fi visual novel. You will play as a life scientist sent from the future to perform clandestine research on transforming ordinary humans into the Enhanced.Force genetic equality or embrace natural selection? Your choices will determine the fate of two timelines.
